_comment: Every tuning number lives here. Times are in seconds unless named otherwise.

lake._comment: The lake fills the bottom of the map. Between the clearing and the lake: a band of forest (chop through it), then the beach.

river._comment: A river runs from the top edge, down the left side of the clearing, into the lake.

beach._comment: Sand along the lake's near shore, leading into the water.

cats._baseWorkRate: How fast cats work compared to you (1.0 = your speed). 0.0035 means a job that takes you 1 second takes a cat ~5 minutes, before each cat's own speed. The game is about planning and waiting.

farm._growth: Crop growMinutes is the time to fully grow while kept watered (8-12 hours). A crop left dry grows (1 + waterGrowthBonus x waterMult) times slower. One watering lasts waterDurationSec.

trees._comment: Trees on the clearing's edge can be chopped to grow the clearing. The outermost woods stay forever.
trees._mix: Relative chance of each tree look: round, pine, birch, wide cloud, tall cloud, spruce, old oak

regrow._comment: The clearing slowly grows a little wild debris back so stone and fiber never run out.
